title: Blinking Bubble-Blenny
statement: Inside a quiet, teal-lit nook of swaying silver sea-grass and carefully stacked amber sea-glass, this tiny, wide-eyed blenny spends its days sorting stray shell fragments by color and puffing neat, rhythmic rings of bubbles. Whenever a visitor peers close, it flutters its feathery brow-tufts in a polite, contemplative blink before tucking itself back inside its favorite sunken porcelain teacup.
